claims.text: The log shows repeated errors indicating that the Apache module mod_jk is encountering a worker named workerEnv stuck in error states 6 and 7 at 06:12:40 on December 4, 2005, followed by a successful initialization of the jk2_init process and workerEnv.init() completing without errors at 06:13:01.
This suggests that although the system recovered and initialized successfully, there was a temporary failure in the mod_jk worker configuration or connection handling just before recovery.
